content.text: You’re in Nigeria, Ghana, or Venezuela. Stripe, PayPal, and Gumroad are unavailable. You sell [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-how-sell-ebooks-kenya-works-how-deploy-17|ebooks]], templates, or beats. Conventional platforms reject your transactions. This guide deploys your sovereign digital commerce stack. No platforms. No subscriptions. Full ownership. You’ll use GitHub Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, Supabase for order storage, and NOWPayments for crypto processing. By the end, you’ll have a live store accepting 300+ cryptocurrencies. No platform fees. No KYC. Lifetime access.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-8. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Start digital

Platforms fail you because they control the infrastructure. Stripe locks you out due to location. Gumroad takes 10% per sale. Your stack bypasses these gatekeepers. GitHub Pages hosts your store for free. Cloudflare Workers automate delivery. Supabase stores orders without fees. NOWPayments verifies crypto payments at 0.5%. You own every component. No platform can shut you down. No subscription ties you in. This is infrastructure sovereignty. Built for creators in regions where conventional tools collapse. Pressure-tested in Zimbabwe against currency collapse and [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/financial-sovereignty-digital-creators-crypto-honest-side-side-16|Financial Sovereignty]] isolation.
What You Need Before You Deploy

You need three things: a digital product, a crypto wallet, and basic internet access. Your product—ebook, template, or software—must be ready for delivery. Your crypto wallet must support BSC, Solana, or TRON for low fees. Internet access must be stable enough to deploy code. You don’t need technical expertise. COREMERCH provides blueprints. You don’t need capital. Free tools power the stack. You don’t need permission. This infrastructure is borderless. Prepare your product files. Set up your wallet. Confirm your internet connection. Deployment begins next.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-start-selling-digital-products-crypto-which-architecture-5|COREMERCH guide to start]] with NOWPayments. Create an account. Generate API keys. Select your preferred cryptocurrency. Set the price in USD. NOWPayments converts at transaction time. Next, deploy your backend. Use Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Write the script to verify payment via NOWPayments webhook. Upon confirmation, trigger file delivery. Use Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 to store product files. Generate secure, expiring download links. Test the pipeline end-to-end. Simulate a purchase. Verify payment confirmation. Ensure file delivery works. Your pipeline is now live. Ready for real transactions.
Gumroad takes 10%. NOWPayments takes 0.5%. At 100 sales of a $97 product, you retain $921 more.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Deploy your store to GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Link your backend script. Embed NOWPayments checkout buttons. Test the live environment. Send a test payment. Confirm the webhook fires. Ensure the file delivers. Share your store URL. Process your first real transaction. Watch the webhook verify payment. See the file deliver automatically. You’ve now sold a digital product without Stripe, PayPal, or Gumroad. No platform took a cut. No KYC was required. Your customer paid in crypto. You retained 99.5% of the revenue.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Your stack is live. Now scale it. Add more products. Reuse the same pipeline. Optimize for higher volume. Upgrade to Supabase for order storage. Configure SPF/DKIM/DMARC for email delivery. Monitor transaction fees. Switch networks if costs rise. BSC, Solana, and TRON keep fees under $0.10. Document your process. Replicate the stack for new stores. Consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197) for all blueprints and templates. Scale without platforms. Scale without fees. Scale with full ownership.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Sell your ebook without PayPal or Stripe by deploying a sovereign commerce stack. Use GitHub Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, and NOWPayments for crypto processing. Upload your ebook to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Write a script to verify payment and deliver the file. Test the pipeline. Go live. Your customers pay in crypto. You retain 99.5% of revenue. No platform fees. No KYC. Full ownership.
Your stack runs on free tools. No subscriptions. No platform fees. Lifetime access.

Instant download at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. Build your digital download store with crypto-only payments. No platform fees. No restrictions. Full sovereignty.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your digital product files. Set up a crypto wallet supporting BSC, Solana, or TRON. Create a NOWPayments account. Generate API keys. Deploy your backend script to Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Test the payment verification webhook. Upload product files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Generate secure download links. Deploy your store to GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Embed NOWPayments checkout buttons. Test the live environment. Share your store URL. Process your first transaction.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I’m not a developer?
Yes. COREMERCH provides blueprints and templates. Follow the step-by-step guides. No coding required. Deploy in 48 hours.
What cryptocurrencies can my customers use?
NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies. Recommend BSC, Solana, or TRON for low fees under $0.10 per transaction.
Do I need to pay recurring fees?
No. The stack uses free tools. NOWPayments charges 0.5% per transaction. No subscriptions. No hidden fees.
Can platforms shut down my store?
No. You own the infrastructure. No platform has access. No platform can shut you down.
How do I handle refunds?
Process refunds manually via your crypto wallet. Document refund policies clearly. Automate refund requests with additional scripts if needed.
